service.description: The organization, base currency and fiscal periods of a statement report, with each period's GL summary rows: a closed period's stored rows, an open period's summed from its posted entries (impl-accounting §4). Refuses a user without report read in the organization, and a period that is not the organization's own; with childOrgPeriods the periods of the organizations that roll up to it are added. asOf, complete and incompleteReasons say what the figures rest on.

parameter.name: summaryRows
parameter.description: The periods' GL summary rows from get#ReportBasicInfo; without them they are read here, which checks the organization and its periods.

service.description: Each account's posted debits, credits and net in one currency (the organization's base currency by default) between two days, by book day, with its balance before and after (design-accounting §13 PostedSummary). Without a fiscal period the through date is included, as this report always read it. Refuses a user without report read in the organization, a fiscal period of another organization and a unit that is not a currency.

An account's posted lines in a fiscal period by book day, with running balances from the period's opening balance (its summary row: stored for a closed period, summed from posted entries for an open one). Refuses a user without report read in the organization and a period of another organization.

service.description: Totals of account classes over groups of the organization's fiscal periods, from each period's GL summary rows (a closed period's stored rows, an open period's posted entries). Refuses a user without report read in the organization and a period that is not the organization's own.

parameter.name: timePeriodIds
parameter.description: Summaries are calculated and returns in an array with an entry for each time period group. If a period group has more than one period in it the total will be across all periods in the group.

parameter.name: dataset
parameter.description: Describes the set of data to include in the results. All map entries are passed through for convenience with 'data' entries added as a List of BigDecimal.

parameter.name: datasetId
parameter.description: If specified this dataset will be added to datasetsById

parameter.name: totalBasis
parameter.description: Can be one of: Posted, PostedNoClosing, Ending. Defaults to PostedNoClosing which is best for income statement accounts.

parameter.name: dataset
parameter.description: The original dataset Map plus a 'data' entry with results as a List of BigDecimal.

service.description: Exports list of rows, each being a list of values. The first row has the dataset label.

Each customer's (or supplier's) movements on the organization's receivable (or payable) accounts between two days or in a fiscal period, by book day, with opening, running and closing balances; each line names its invoice, payment or journal entry. More than 5,000 lines are named (complete false, incompleteReason) and their balances unavailable. Refuses a user without report read in the organization, a period of another organization, a party another user keeps private and a unit that is not a currency.

The invoice reconciliation of an organization's fiscal period, for receivables or payables: documents whose open amount differs from their receivable or payable postings, payments whose applied amount differs from theirs, unposted and unbalanced transactions, receivable or payable postings without an invoice and applications of the period to later invoices, each row with its document and ledger amounts; and the aging's open total against the ledger balance at the period's end. Refuses a user without report read in the organization, and a period of another organization.

parameter.name: listLimit
parameter.description: The most documents or transactions of each kind checked; a check with more is reported incomplete (incompleteChecks)

service.description: The aging of an organization's receivables (or payables) as of a day, today by default: each invoice open on that day (issued by then, less what was applied by then), each portion of its due schedule in the bucket of its days past due on that day (current, four periods of periodDays, and over), by party and currency, with the totals of each currency and, for one party, its invoices. Days are calendar days, so a past day buckets the same on every database. More than 5,000 open invoices are named (complete false, incompleteReason), never cut silently. Refuses a day after today, and a user without report read, or the side's view permission, in the organization.
